transcript.text: Today we are making traditional Chicken Tikka Masala.
For the marinade, you need 500g chicken thighs cut into cubes,
1 cup Greek yogurt, 2 tablespoons lemon juice,
and 1 tablespoon garam masala with 1 teaspoon turmeric.
Mix well and marinate for at least 30 minutes. [Applause]
For the sauce: sauté 1 diced onion, 3 minced garlic cloves, and 1 tablespoon grated ginger in butter.
Add 400g canned tomatoes and simmer for 15 minutes.
Stir in 100ml heavy cream, add the grilled chicken, and garnish with fresh cilantro.
